text:
alex: Hey team — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/branch-14122|#14122> is blocked by a flaky snapshot in the integration suite. Failing test: `integration/visual/header-resize.test.ts`

alex: Quick paste from CI logs:
```
--- FAIL: header-resize (t=4.2s)
expected snapshot to match actual (diff 1.2kB)
snapshot: header-resize-2026-03-15-3.png
found small horizontal shift in logo area
```

alex: I don't want to just update the snapshot without a quick check — could someone rerun shard 4 and eyeball the diff? If it consistently passes, we can merge; if it flakes again, we'll open a follow-up issue. :eyes:

jamie: Linking the PR. Will rerun now. Do you know if this was introduced by the css tweak in 7f3c2d3?

alex: Yup commit `7f3c2d3` is the tip. The CSS tweak was minor (padding tweak around header). Historically similar flickers have been transient.

jamie: OK kicking a rerun for integration/shard=4 — using the manual rerun CLI: `./dev/ci/rerun --pr=14122 --job=integration --shard=4`

ci-bot: rerun started for job=integration shard=4 (triggered by jamie). Job id: run_2026_1765432152.

jamie: First run looks red tho — small diff still there. Attaching short stack of images for quick review: https://ci.redwood.dev/run_2026_1765432152/diffs

sasha: I can take a look. Known pattern: small pixel shifts from font metrics or timing in the headless renderer. If the diff is just a 1px shift in the logo area it's usually safe to update, but want to confirm non-determinism. Planning a second rerun. :mag_right:

jamie: Second rerun queued. If second run passes, I'd be comfortable approving snapshot update + merging. If it fails again, we should revert the CSS tweak or add a tolerant snapshot.

ci-bot: rerun completed — run_2026_1765432299: PASSED on shard=4 (no diffs).

jamie: Looks green on second try. Sasha, can you take the diff from the passed run and confirm it's the transient 1px shift? If yes please update snapshot and leave an approval comment.

sasha: Reviewing now. Downloaded both images, overlay shows shift of ~1px horizontally only on one run. Not related to layout regressions. Will update snapshot with `yarn test integration -u --shard=4` and push the snapshot update commit to the PR.

alex: Awesome — thanks. Once snapshot update is pushed can someone from infra or jamie approve so I can merge? I don't want the PR to sit behind the queue. :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: If you hit repeated nondeterministic flakes across merges let us know — we can pin headless-chrome version on CI or increase renderer timeout. For this one sounds transient.

sasha: Pushed snapshot update commit `b2a9f4d` to branch-14122 and left review comment: "Updated visual snapshot for header-resize — verified transient 1px shift on one run."

jamie: Approved and merging now. Thanks all.

alex: Merged. I'll watch the canary deploy and open an infra ticket if more flakes appear.

ci-bot: deployment to canary started: deploy_2026_1765435390.

alex: follow-up: creating a short note in the PR about flaky visual tests and how to rerun (`./dev/ci/rerun ...`) so others can follow.
